source_caption_text:
A first look at the official gameplay for Yeat’s new Fortnite skin 👀🤯

Yeat is officially bringing his world to Fortnite with his own Icon Series collaboration 🛸🔥

Revealed through the “Real Lyfe” trailer, the collab is scheduled to arrive in the Item Shop on October 15 at 8 p.m. ET. The release includes two outfits, two back blings, two emotes and more, giving fans new ways to bring Yeat’s style into the game. Three of his best-known songs—“If We Being Rëal,” “Monëy So Big” and “Gët Busy”—are also joining Fortnite as Jam Tracks. 

The rollout started before the official reveal, with Yeat teasing that something was happening soon on Instagram and a “FORTNITË” projection appearing on New York City’s Washington Square Arch. The collection takes inspiration from his recognizable look, including beanies, sunglasses, chains and tattoos, with green reactive effects featured in the designs. Additional accessories are expected to include a pickaxe, microphone instrument, wrap and kicks.
